subject: Life Skills
title: Phishing Anatomy
description: A fast breakdown of Phishing Anatomy for builders.

hook.text: The email looked exactly like a real bank notice. Logo, colors, even the footer matched.

buildup.text: Phishing emails now use AI to mimic corporate tone perfectly. Grammar mistakes are no longer a reliable signal.

discovery.text: Always check the sender's actual email address, not the display name.

twist.text: Spear phishing targets you personally using your name, job title, and recent activity. It feels like a real colleague.

climax.text: When in doubt, never click the link. Open a new browser tab and go directly to the company's official website.

punchline.text: Hover, verify, go direct. Never trust the link.

quiz.question: What is the safest action when you receive a suspicious email?
options: Reply to ask if it is legitimate
Open a new tab and navigate to the company's site directly
Click the link to check if it looks real
